purpose: One registered confirmatory evaluation of the already-frozen Phase 2 A2 routing configuration. The test result cannot alter model, calibration, threshold, cost weights, or hypotheses.

H3_confirmatory.question: Does the frozen calibrated A2 decision policy reduce damaging automatic-routing cost relative to the frozen raw-A2 comparator on independent BANKING77 test cases?
H3_confirmatory.independence_reason: Only the BANKING77 test in-domain component is unseen. The 160-query synthetic OOS benchmark was used during development and therefore cannot supply independent confirmatory evidence.
H3_confirmatory.calibrated_policy: A2 temperature-scaled confidence with temperature 0.457974 and threshold 0.892704
H3_confirmatory.support_rule: supported if the paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval upper bound for temperature-minus-raw mean in-domain cost is below 0
H3_confirmatory.unsupported_rule: unsupported if the paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound is at or above 0

H4_confirmatory.question: Does selective abstention reduce routing error risk on independent BANKING77 test cases?
H4_confirmatory.coverage_rule: accept exactly round(0.75 * 3080) highest calibrated-confidence test rows; stable sample-id order breaks exact-confidence ties
H4_confirmatory.support_rule: supported if the paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval upper bound for selective-risk-minus-full-risk is below 0
H4_confirmatory.unsupported_rule: unsupported if the paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound is at or above 0
H4_confirmatory.frozen_threshold_secondary: also report realized coverage, selective risk, event counts, and in-domain cost at threshold 0.892704 without changing that threshold

uncertainty.H3_resampling_unit: BANKING77 test row; paired raw/calibrated row costs retained together
uncertainty.H4_resampling_unit: BANKING77 test row; full automation and 75% selective policy recomputed within each bootstrap sample
